{{Top|leg|canon=Imperial combat engineer}}
An '''Imperial Combat Engineer''' was a specialist within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. They utilized [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] to assist in their work. Nine troops could be organized into a [[engineering squad]]. With one of them been a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], another been a demolition expert with military experience in a [[sharpshooter squad]]. And seven other been regular combat engineers. Similar to the sharpshooter squad members, members of the engineering squads were drawn from among the [[Imperial Army Special Missions trooper/Legends|special missions troopers]]. Their predecessors were the [[clone engineer]]s.
